DiffusionOPD Reporting Glossary

This page defines the core terms used across Gollek’s DiffusionOPD reporting, query, and inspection docs.

Use it when you understand the general workflow but want a quick vocabulary reference for the artifact and selector language.

Terms

adaptive section

The normalized report section that records adaptive stage-weighting behavior, including the trainer’s stage-factor updates and related weighting metadata.

baseline report

The earlier or expected DiffusionOpdReport used as the comparison anchor for campaign, release, and delivery queries.

bundle

A directory of generated inspection artifacts exported from one report through the inspector. A bundle usually contains multiple rendered files plus a manifest.json.

bundle health

A compact integrity view over a bundle that answers whether the bundle is complete, which files are missing, and how severe the missing or failing checks are.

bundle manifest

The manifest.json file written into a bundle directory. It describes the bundle type, source report path, output format, creation time, and the files advertised by the bundle.

campaign lane

The higher-level orchestration layer that converts baseline-versus-current report differences into approval, incident, resolution, closure, release, and delivery artifacts.

canonical export lane

The newer release-delivery path built around the ...Export... public APIs. This is the preferred downstream path for new integrations.

compatibility lane

The older release-delivery public shape that is still available for callers who need aggregate delivery records instead of the canonical export-delivery model.

conditioning section

The normalized report section that captures conditioning-lane diagnostics such as task-specific text-conditioning usage and loss aggregates.

current report

The newer or observed DiffusionOpdReport being analyzed against a baseline.

export lane

Shorthand for the canonical release-delivery export lane. It produces explicit export-oriented report, ledger, receipt, acknowledgement, decision, resolution, closure, and handoff views.

generated file

One output artifact inside a bundle, such as a JSON, CSV, table, or text file advertised by the bundle manifest.

grouped summary

A rollup keyed by one dimension, such as task, teacher, or stage. Examples include taskSummaries, teacherSummaries, and stageSummaries.

handoff bundle

A terminal bundle-shaped artifact that groups the final artifacts in a release or delivery lane so downstream systems can consume one packaged view rather than reconstructing the chain themselves.

inspector

The report/bundle inspection surface exposed through the DiffusionOPD JBang wrapper and the underlying Java support APIs.

latest row

The most recent round-history row after a selector filter has been applied.

manifest

Context decides the meaning:

  • for report bundles, it usually means manifest.json inside a bundle
  • for campaign or release flows, it can also mean an export-style manifest record family representing a flattened downstream package

paired summary

A rollup keyed by two dimensions, such as task/teacher, task/stage, or teacher/stage. Examples include taskTeacherSummaries, taskStageSummaries, and teacherStageSummaries.

projection

The column or preset selection applied to table or csv output. Examples include explicit columns like value,count,meanLoss and presets like compact or compare.

query surface

The typed Java analysis APIs exposed by DiffusionOpdReportQueries.

report

Usually means the normalized diffusion-opd-report.json artifact or its typed Java representation, DiffusionOpdReport.

round-history row

One normalized training-history row representing one observed slice of OPD behavior, including round index, task, teacher, stage, and loss values.

selector

A compact string expression used by the JBang inspector to choose one report section, one filtered history slice, one summary rollup, or one bundle view.

selector reference

The quick-lookup document for selector syntax, bundle grammar, projections, and bundle health filters.

stage-aware routing

The ability to route one task’s OPD supervision through different teachers or teacher bindings depending on denoising stage or timestep interval.

summary preset

A shorthand selector like taskSummary=ocr or teacherSummary=ocr-early that returns one compact pre-aggregated summary for a specific slice.

top-level section

One first-class section inside the normalized report, such as run, artifacts, teachers, conditioning, adaptive, or roundHistory.

typed report

The Java record-based representation of diffusion-opd-report.json, loaded through DiffusionOpdReports.

workflow lane

The layer that turns report-derived analysis into operator-facing planning artifacts such as workflow action packets, execution plans, dispatch envelopes, and campaign approval/incident artifacts.
